title: Westgate Condo #4803A | KEY.co
description_expanded: You may ship items using FedEx, UPS, or Amazon during the week prior to arrival and/or while you are in the home, however, we cannot guarantee delivery or security of the package. Please do not ship US Postal Service -- they do not deliver to many of our locations and you are likely to not receive your package if sent USPS. Please refer to the shipping instructions within your confirmation. We are not responsible for any lost, damaged, or delayed deliveries. Returning late deliveries after a guest has left will incur an additional fee, plus cost of shipping. The Westgate combines elegance with comfort, providing a serene haven amidst the bustling village. Its sophisticated interiors are adorned with plush furnishings and modern amenities, creating a welcoming atmosphere perfect for relaxation. Whether savoring the stunning mountain views, unwinding by the cozy fireplace, or exploring the endless recreational and cultural offerings, every stay at The Westgate is destined to be an unforgettable blend of luxury and adventure.
